guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 将你的钱包连接到 Wager Predict 测试网
guide.description: 访问 Wager Predict 应用程序并连接 MetaMask 或任何 WalletConnect 钱包。点击水龙头按钮，即可获取免费的 tBNB Gas。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect Your Wallet to the Wager Predict Testnet
guide.original_description: Visit the Wager Predict app and connect MetaMask or any WalletConnect wallet. Grab free tBNB for gas by clicking the faucet button.

guide.title: 领取 10,000 测试网 USDC
guide.description: 打开应用内的水龙头并领取。该领取将 10,000 个测试 USDC 直接发送到你的钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the in-app faucet and claim. The claim sends 10,000 test USDC straight to your wallet.

guide.title: 批准 USDC 并进行第一笔交易
guide.description: 选择一个实时市场，选择“是”或“否”，然后输入金额。你的第一笔交易需要在购买确认之前获得一次性批准交易。每笔交易的费用为 2%，卖出就像买入一样，因此你可以在到期前一小时退出任何头寸。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Approve USDC and Place Your First Trade
guide.original_description: Pick a live market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Your first trade needs a one-time approval transaction before the buy confirms. Fees are 2% per trade, and selling works like buying, so you can exit any position up to one hour before expiry.

guide.title: 跨市场交易并测试杠杆
guide.description: 将赌注分散到各个类别，而不是把所有东西都放在一个市场上。然后尝试杠杆头寸； 5x 和 10x 等级在销量较高的市场上解锁。强平使用 30 分钟的平均赔率而不是即期赔率，因此一笔不稳定的交易不会立即让你平仓。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Trade Across Markets and Test Leverage
guide.original_description: Spread bets across categories rather than parking everything in one market. Then try a leveraged position; 5x and 10x tiers unlock on higher-volume markets. Liquidations use a 30-minute average of the odds rather than spot, so one erratic trade will not instantly close you out.

guide.title: 创建你自己的市场
guide.description: 前往市场创建页面，写下措辞清晰的问题，并提供明确的解决方案来源。该协议提供了流动性，因此你无需承担做市风险，并且你可以终身收取市场上每笔交易的 0.5%。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Head to the market creation page and write a clearly worded question with an unambiguous resolution source. The protocol seeds the liquidity, so you take no market-making risk, and you collect 0.5% of every trade on your market for life.

guide.title: LP Vault 的股份
guide.description: 将测试 USDC 存入 LP 金库，该金库向杠杆交易者提供贷款并向储户支付一定费用。 Flex、90、180 和 365 天的锁定等级可享受 1 倍、2 倍、4 倍和 8 倍的积分乘数，并且该乘数仅在锁定处于活动状态时适用。即使在 Flex 上，提款也有 7 天的冷却时间。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Deposit test USDC into the LP vault, which lends to leveraged traders and pays depositors a cut of their fees. Lock tiers of Flex, 90, 180, and 365 days carry point multipliers of 1x, 2x, 4x, and 8x, and the multiplier only applies while the lock is active. Withdrawals sit through a 7-day cooldown, even on Flex.

guide.title: 攀登第 01 季排行榜
guide.description: 在排行榜上跟踪你的损益，完成新手入门成就，并在交易时收集徽章。从仪表盘分享你的邀请链接以引入其他交易者。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Track your P&L on the leaderboard, work through the onboarding achievements, and collect badges as you trade. Share your referral link from the dashboard to bring in other traders.
